notes: Blueprints describe JLPT test STRUCTURE only. Questions are sampled from the
canonical question bank at attempt time, so no question content is duplicated
here and a blueprint stays in sync with the bank automatically.
The real JLPT has three sections; the listening section (聴解) is intentionally
deferred until the platform has an audio domain, which is why it is recorded in
metadata.listeningPlanned rather than as a section that can never be filled.

tests.title: JLPT N5 Mock Test 1
tests.titleJa: 日本語能力試験 N5 模擬テスト 1
tests.subtitle: Timed full-section mock · 文字・語彙 + 文法・読解
tests.description: A timed N5 mock built from the canonical NihongoBridge question bank. Two sections mirror the paper-based N5 layout; the listening section arrives with the platform's audio domain.
tests.instructions: Answer every question. Each section has its own time limit and a minimum score. The clock starts as soon as the attempt is created and does not pause.

metadata.listeningNote: 聴解 (listening) is planned once audio attachments exist in the knowledge domain.
